p: whole piece shalt thou make them: Or, of work beaten out with the hammer.
east parts shall go forward: That is, the host of Judah and they that are under his ensign.
south side shall take their journey: Meaning, the heart of Reuben.
blow with the trumpets: So that only the priests must blow the trumpets, as long as the priesthood lasted.
gladness: When you rejoice that God has removed any plague.
first took their journey according to: From Sinai to Paran, Nu 33:1.
the tabernacle: With all the belongings of it.
bearing the sanctuary: Upon their shoulders.
the other did set up the: The Merarites and Gershonites.
rereward of all the camps throughout: Leaving none behind, nor any of the former that fainted in the way.
Thus were the journeyings of the: This was the order of their host when they travelled.
Hobab: Some think that Reuel, Jethro, Hobab, and Keni were all one: Kimhi says that Reuel was Jethro's father: so Hobab was Moses father-in-law, see Ex 2:18,3:1,4:18,18:1; Jud 4:11
mount of the LORD three days': Mount Sinai, or Horeb.
Rise up: Declare your might and power.
